obligation_reference.atomic_summary: An authorised provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.
obligation_reference.approval_rationale: Accepted for synthetic assurance design subject to the fictional licensing assumption.

scope_limitations: Synthetic evidence proves schema behaviour, not real control effectiveness.

mapping.coverage_rationale: Complaint handling and customer-outcomes oversight jointly address establishment, operation and maintenance of the synthetic complaints framework.

control_mappings.mapping_rationale: This control operates the core complaint identification, escalation, resolution and remediation elements of the approved obligation.
control_mappings.control_objective: Complaints are consistently identified, recorded, investigated, escalated and remediated under the approved framework.
control_mappings.control_description: The Complaints Manager maintains the framework and register, reviews case classification and ageing, and records escalation and customer remediation decisions.
control_mappings.frequency_or_trigger: For every complaint, with monthly register review

acceptance_criteria: identifies accountable roles and escalation paths
covers classification, investigation, remediation and oversight

expected_evidence.description: Complaint register with classification, escalation, resolution and remediation fields

supplied_evidence.title: Synthetic Complaints Register Extract - 2026 Q2
limitations: Aggregate synthetic extract; individual case files were not assessed.

evidence_assessment.rationale: The supplied synthetic framework and period register meet the defined acceptance criteria for this schema example.
limitations: This conclusion is limited to the supplied synthetic artefacts and is not a real effectiveness opinion.

control_mappings.mapping_rationale: Management-information review provides oversight that the complaints framework remains active and responsive to root causes and remediation trends.
control_mappings.control_objective: Complaint trends, root causes and remediation outcomes receive accountable management oversight.
control_mappings.control_description: The Conduct Risk Officer reviews monthly customer-outcomes information and records governance challenge and follow-up actions.

expected_evidence.description: Customer-outcomes report covering complaint volumes, root causes and remediation trends
acceptance_criteria: includes complaint root causes and remediation trends

supplied_evidence.title: Synthetic Customer Outcomes Management Information - July 2026

evidence_assessment.rationale: The supplied synthetic report covers the required oversight fields and records review.

assurance_assessment.rationale: The approved obligation is mapped to the complaint operation and customer-outcomes oversight controls, with the required synthetic design and operating evidence supplied.

routing.routing_rationale: Conduct Risk owns the outcome assessment; Compliance and the operating control owner approve the mapping and evidence conclusion.
